text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. A request was received by Councillor Ana Bailão to reduce the permit parking hours on Pelham Avenue, between Osler Street, between Osler Street and Uxbridge Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., 7 days a week to 12:01 a.m. to 8:00 a.m., 7 days a week.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the reduction of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Pelham Avenue, between Osler Street and Uxbridge Avenue, from 12:01 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., 7 days a week to 12:01 a.m. to 8:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
